data.name: HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads

data.description: HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads uses GR00T N1.
HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads uses Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).
HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads uses Whole-Body Control (WBC).
